objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction or other controlled document subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Free-text title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time span for validity checks, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation, default 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related master data, IT applications, relevant companies or areas of validity.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Applicability scope printed via TAG technology.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is versioned independently but released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A non-controlled supplementary information object linked to a document, not subject to the release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional information is directly published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal to amend an existing released document, managed independently until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Details of the proposed change.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggering a workflow to check and extend the validity of a document before expiry.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a released document and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document management processes in various roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System/license role assigned to the user (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution lists.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Archive).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that routes tasks through defined steps (e.g. Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A recorded digital signature captured during workflow task completion, documented per participant per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step in which the signature was captured.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A configurable list of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A recorded confirmation by a recipient that they have taken note of a released document version.

attributes.name: confirmed
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed.

attributes.name: recipient
attributes.description: Person who is requested to acknowledge.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation or search report available in the system for documents.

attributes.name: report_name
attributes.description: Name of the report (e.g. Status report: Documents & Instruction, Search for documents & instructions).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Configurable parameters that filter report results.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific user interface view listing relevant documents and tasks.

attributes.name: dashboard_type
attributes.description: Type of dashboard (e.g. Reader, Author).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with a selected document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval workflow for a document is initiated by the author or a co-author, beginning the 3-step release process.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first Creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for distribution to readers during the release workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling subsequent tasks.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes or scheduled change proposals.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for creating the new version (e.g. content change, attachment change, change proposal).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is edited, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional non-controlled information is added to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Non-critical additional information is directly deleted from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, marking it as completed.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) confirms that the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The override workflow completes and the document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated with a new version, restoring authorizations and distribution settings.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for email or acknowledgement distribution.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to users about a release, workflow task, validity extension or other event.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (e.g. release, workflow task, validity extension, acknowledgement request).

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon document release, persons on the acknowledgement distribution list are requested to confirm they have taken note.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow-supported task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates released document content into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is reviewed and released via a workflow with signature.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the document is physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment is linked to and released together with its main Document.
Additional Info is supplementary information attached to a Document.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific Document.
A Request for Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity must be checked.
A Request for Override is created for a specific Document to invalidate it.
A Request for Reactivation references the archived Document to be reactivated.
A Document Template is associated with a document type and used when creating new Documents.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to control notification and acknowledgement.
A Distribution List contains assigned User Groups for distribution.
A Distribution List contains directly assigned individual Users.
A User is a member of one or more User Groups that determine their authorizations and roles.
A Document can reference another Document (e.g. local extension referencing original, or cross-references).
An Acknowledgement records a recipient's confirmation for a specific released Document version.

o2e.description: A Document is created by this event.
A Document Template may be selected during document creation.
A User (author) performs the creation of a document.
A Document's content is edited.
A User (author or co-author) edits the document content.
A Document's metadata and attributes are maintained.
A User maintains the document properties.
A Document is automatically converted to PDF.
A Document is the subject of the initiated release workflow.
A Workflow instance is created for the release process.
A User (author or co-author) initiates the release workflow.
The Document is signed by the author in the creator step.
The registered author User signs in the creator step.
An Electronic Signature is captured during the creator step.
A Document is reviewed for technical and formal correctness.
A User (reviewer) performs the document review.
An Electronic Signature is captured during document review.
A Document is approved for release.
A User (releaser) approves the document.
An Electronic Signature is captured during document approval.
A Document is rejected during review or release.
A User (reviewer or releaser) rejects the document.
The Workflow is canceled for subsequent participants upon rejection.
A Document is published and made visible to readers.
A new version of the Document is created.
An Attachment is created.
The main Document is affected by creation of a new Attachment.
A User (author) creates the Attachment.
An Attachment is modified.
The main Document gets a new version due to Attachment modification.
An Attachment is marked for archiving.
The main Document is affected by archiving of its Attachment.
Additional Info is added to a document.
The Document receives supplementary Additional Info.
A User (author) adds the Additional Info.
Additional Info is deleted from a document.
A Change Proposal is created.
The Change Proposal targets this Document.
A User with author rights creates the Change Proposal.
A Change Proposal is scheduled for implementation.
A new version of the Document is created when the Change Proposal is scheduled.
A Change Proposal is documented as completed.
The author User documents the completion of the Change Proposal.
A Request for Validity Extension is created by the system.
The Document triggers the validity extension request.
The Document's validity is extended with an updated Valid Until date.
The Request for Validity Extension is resolved and deleted upon extension.
A User (releaser, and optionally author/reviewer) extends the validity.
A Workflow supports the validity extension process.
A Request for Override is created.
The Document is the target of the override request.
A User with write access creates the override request.
The Document is declared out of force and archived.
The Request for Override is retained for documentation after override.
A User (releaser) declares the document out of force.
A Workflow supports the override process.
The Archive User Group retains read access after override.
A Request for Reactivation is created.
The archived Document is selected for reactivation.
A User in the Business Admin group creates the reactivation request.
The Document is reactivated with a new version.
Archived Attachments are reactivated along with the Document.
The Request for Reactivation drives the reactivation event.
A Workflow supports the reactivation process.
The initiator User confirms reactivation in the workflow.
Authorizations are assigned to the Document.
A User Group is assigned authorization on the Document.
Individual Users may be assigned personal authorizations.
A Distribution List is configured for a document.
The Document's distribution settings are maintained.
A User maintains the distribution list.
A User receives an email notification.
The notification relates to a Document event.
Acknowledgement is requested for the released Document.
Users on the acknowledgement distribution list are requested to acknowledge.
An Acknowledgement is confirmed by the recipient.
A User confirms acknowledgement of a document.
The acknowledgement relates to a specific Document version.
A released Document is translated into another language.
A User (translator) performs the translation.
The translated version of a Document is released.
Users (reviewer and releaser for translation) release the translated version.
A Workflow supports the translation release process.
Electronic Signatures are captured during translation release.
A Document is physically deleted after the archive period expires.
